sentences.text:
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDER, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

This petition under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. is filed by the petitioner - accused No.1 to enlarge him on bail in Crime No.246/2022, registered by the Jewargi Police Station, for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 354(D), 376 (2) (N), 376 (3), 344, 506 and 509 of IPC and Sections 4, 6 and 12 of the POCSO Act.

The summary of the charge-sheet is that, petitioner - accused No.1 forcibly took the victim by promising to marry her to Bengaluru on 31.10.2022 and till 14.11.2022 he committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault.
On 15.11.2022, when the petitioner - accused No.1 had gone out of the rental house, the Bengaluru Police came to the house and taken back the victim to Jewargi on the complaint lodged.
03. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner - accused No.1 and the learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent - State.

Mahantesh vs State And Anr on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7869054/
2 04.

The allegation against the petitioner - accused No.1 is that by promising to marry the victim, he had taken the victim to Bengaluru on 31.10.2022 and had kept her in confined in a rented house,
and committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault.
The victim in her statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. has stated that she was aged about 17 years on the date of incident.
Whether it is a case of elope or kidnap, is the matter which requires to be proved at the time of trial.
At this stage, the petitioner - accused No.1 has made out a prima-facie case to enlarge him on bail.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER
The Criminal petition is allowed.

The Petitioner - accused No.1 is enlarged on bail in Crime No.246/2022, registered by the Jewargi Police Station, for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 354 (D), 376 (2) (N), 376 (3), 344, 506 and 509 of IPC and Sections 4, 6 and 12 of the POCSO Act, subject to the following conditions:
(a) Petitioner - accused No.1 shall furnish a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1 lakh with one surety for the likesum to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional Court.
(b) He shall appear before the Court as and when required.
NC: 2023:KHC-K:1206 (c) He shall not threaten or allure the prosecution witnesses in whatsoever manner.
(d) He shall not get involved in similar offences.
(e) He shall not leave the territorial limits of the Trial Court without prior permission of the Trial Court.
